brief.text:
GANGSTAS PARADISE (Sleeper) — no change from this morning: lineup locked in, every Q is trending toward clearing
Do now: nothing — lineup is set
Locks next 24h: none — first kickoff is Wed 5:20 PM PT (Myers vs NE, Yahoo side); Sleeper's first game is Herbert/Hampton Sun 1:25 PM PT vs ARI
Lineup: no changes since this morning. Higgins (heel) still DNP-tagged but Taylor calls it minor and full participation is expected before kickoff; Flowers (quad) is back to full practice and Baltimore is optimistic; Downs (calf) is back on the field and called it "very minor." Tuten's illness update from Jacksonville beat writers confirms it was a one-day, non-injury scratch from practice with a full week to clear — the real swing factor on his workload stays Jacksonville's 3-way RB rotation with Rodriguez and Allen, not the illness. If Higgins, Flowers, or Downs is out: start Diggs. If Tuten is out: start Woody Marks.
Analysis highlights: Hampton is a smash play — ARI allowed the 2nd-most fantasy points to RBs in 2025 and LAC is an 11.5-pt home favorite (28.5 implied), with SoFi's fixed roof taking weather off the table entirely. Chase Brown and Higgins face a Tampa Bay defense that graded out bottom-tier overall in 2025, riding the week's highest total (50.5). Flowers gets the softest individual matchup on the roster — IND allowed the 2nd-most fantasy points to WRs last year.

GAME OF THROWS (Yahoo) — Isaiah Likely is trending toward NOT playing Week 1 — have Okonkwo ready; Parker Washington's stale injury flag is now cleared — he's healthy; still a 39% underdog vs GIBBBBBYYYY, no new screenshots since yesterday
Do now: Likely (recovering from a surgically-repaired foot fracture) still hasn't returned to practice and remains unlikely for Week 1 — swap in Chig Okonkwo the moment NYG rules him out
Locks next 24h: none — first kickoff is Wed 5:20 PM PT (Myers vs NE)
Lineup: one real call this week — Likely to Okonkwo. Parker Washington's injury report is now confirmed clean (no lingering issue) — full go, caveat lifted. Judkins draws the toughest matchup on either roster (JAX run defense, only 16.75 implied as a road dog) but there's no better flex on your bench, so he stays in — temper expectations. If Likely is out: start Chig Okonkwo.
Analysis highlights: Etienne's implied total sits at just 21.25 as a 7-point road dog at Detroit, but the intact co-lead role next to Kamara carries him regardless. Garrett Wilson gets a plus matchup on paper at Tennessee but the week's lowest total (39.5, 19.0 implied) caps his ceiling. Pickens and Likely (if he plays) both get the week's best matchup for a pass-catcher — Dallas visits a bottom-5 NYG defense Sunday night.

FYI: Chase Brown starts in both leagues; Michael Wilson sits on both benches; four Jaguars are rostered across the two leagues (Tuten, Strange, Jaguars D/ST on Sleeper, Parker Washington on Yahoo). Checked the direct handcuffs behind your Sleeper/Yahoo starting RBs (Perine behind Chase Brown, Vidal/Mitchell behind Hampton, Estime behind Etienne, Sampson behind Judkins) — no news on any of them.

news.headline: Bengals' Tee Higgins: Dealing with heel injury
news.summary: Higgins sat out Wednesday's practice with a heel contusion, but coach Zac Taylor called it minor and expects him ready for kickoff.

news.headline: Ravens Got Good Zay Flowers News Ahead of Colts Week 1 Game
news.summary: Flowers is back to full practice after a quad contusion and the Ravens sound confident he'll be available for the opener.

news.headline: Jaguars' Bhayshul Tuten: Misses practice with illness
news.summary: Tuten was sent home from an early-week practice with an illness, but beat writers expect it to clear well before kickoff.

news.headline: Colts news: Josh Downs downplays calf injury with 'very minor' assurance
news.summary: Downs called his calf issue very minor and precautionary, and he's already back on the practice field ahead of Week 1.

news.headline: Isaiah Likely not expected to play in Week 1 due to foot injury, per report
news.summary: Likely is still working back from a surgically-repaired foot fracture and remains unlikely to be ready for the season opener.

news.headline: Parker Washington (undisclosed) day-to-day
news.summary: The undisclosed issue that had Washington day-to-day in late August has resolved and he now carries no injury designation.
